10/2021 09/2025

Pune

Led advanced analytics initiatives that delivered $2M in measurable business impact through efficiency gains, cost optimization, and revenue-enabling insights. • Built and maintained 20 enterprise Power BI & Tableau dashboards serving 200

business users, reducing decision latency by 60%.

Designed and optimized Databricks-based ETL pipelines processing 5 TB of data monthly, cutting transformation latency by 25%.

Created scalable Erwin data models across critical business functions, reducing query response times by 35% and enabling selfservice analytics.

Automated 30 reporting workflows, saving 500 hours annually and significantly improving analytics productivity and governance reliability.

Delivered analytics leadership across 3 major business launches, driving $1.2M in business impact. Implemented Salesforce data automation and validation pipelines, improving data accuracy by 89% and reducing QA workload by 75%.



Designed and implemented data quality scorecards and control frameworks, and improving data completeness across enterprise reporting.

Partnered with business, risk, and technology stakeholders to identify, investigate, and resolve complex data concerns, reducing false positives and improving trust across reporting streams.

Led root-cause data investigations using SQL and Python, enabling accurate understanding of pattern exceptions and influencing data reliability recommendations.

Led statistical and exploratory data analysis EDA initiatives using Python to detect anomalies, identify risk patterns, and support governance-aligned decisioning — driving 15% efficiency improvement and $800K in cost optimization. SUMMARY Senior Data Analytics & Platform Engineer with 9 years of experience driving enterprise analytics, data governance, and reporting transformation across global Fintech and BFSI organisations. Proven expertise in architecting enterprise BI platforms, scalable ETL pipelines, and statistical analytics frameworks for exploratory data analysis EDA , anomaly detection, and data risk identification. Recognized for delivering multi- million-dollar business impact through automation, data quality controls, and compliance-aligned reporting solutions. A trusted cross-functional partner skilled in resolving complex data issues, strengthening regulatory readiness, and enabling faster, more reliable executive decision-making.

EDUCATION Bachelor of Computer Engineering NBN Sinhgad School of Engineering

Diploma in Computer Engineering Maharashtra Institute of Technology

01/2008 01/2011

Pune

Owned and scaled 100 ETL workflows processing 10 TB of data weekly, improving pipeline throughput by 40%.

Led Hadoop-based enterprise data engineering architecture, tripling ingestion speed and improving downstream analytics readiness.

Designed star and snowflake schemas supporting BI and data warehousing across 7 business departments. Instituted enterprise data quality frameworks reducing reporting discrepancies by 65%.



Managed NLP chatbot QA, leading a 5-member team,



validating 1,000 conversational scenarios and improving response accuracy by 22%. Implemented metadata lineage and compliance traceability across 30 systems supporting regulatory audits.

resolution rate. Implemented metadata lineage and traceability frameworks that improved audit readiness and compliance across 30 enterprise systems.
